references.text: The context of the verse - Moses' father-in-law observed Moses' daily work of judging the people
Jethro's response and advice after seeing what Moses did - he warned that this was not good
Moses complains about the burden of leading the people alone, and God gives him seventy elders to help
Moses explains how he could not carry the people alone and needed help with judging
Instructions on bringing difficult cases to the priests and judges
The apostles realized they could not handle all tasks alone and delegated service at the tables to others
Exodus 18:14 outlines the practical overload that Moses later describes in Numbers 11:11 as an unbearable spiritual burden.
Verse 24 is the direct response to the issue raised in verse 14, showing that Moses' attentiveness leads to a better leadership structure.
